purpose: Disclosed book_concentration inputs for measure_book.py --live. Each row is the entity's DISCLOSED gross written premium split: total GWP plus the premium written in named energy/power (and any named data-centre/tech) lines, from a Lloyd's syndicate 'class of business' table or company segmental/SFCR reporting. NO synthetic values — leave an entity OUT until you have its real, sourced figures. The script skips any entity not present here.

instructions.total_gwp: total gross written premium (number, same currency as below)
instructions.energy_power_gwp: premium in named energy/power class(es) only. Use the NARROWEST named class; do NOT use broad Solvency II Fire/Property LoBs (they over-include).
instructions.datacentre_tech_gwp: premium in any named data-centre/tech class (optional; omit if not separately disclosed)
instructions.currency: e.g. 'GBP', 'USD' — units of the figures (millions assumed in rationale)
instructions.lines_counted: array of the exact class names you summed, e.g. ['Energy','Renewables']
instructions.source: primary URL to the syndicate annual report / segmental disclosure
instructions.applies_to: risk-carriers only (insurer, lloyds_syndicate, reinsurer). Computed ONLY where a named energy/power premium is disclosed; otherwise book_concentration stays assessed.
